Subject: Proposed weekly MAP checkpoint: evaluation plan & owners

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency/cost analysis. We want to stand up a short weekly checkpoint to keep momentum on the MAP and finalize the evaluation plan and close timeline. Proposed: 30-minute recurring meeting where we review outstanding blockers, share evaluation results, and assign next-week owners.

Suggested cadence: weekly on Thursdays, 10:00am PT. Initial agenda (30m):
- 5m: quick status (green/amber/red)
- 10m: evaluation readouts (metrics, sample outputs)
- 10m: blockers & next actions
- 5m: confirm owner rotations and deliverables

Attached: ACME_MAP_EvalPlan_v2.pdf (evaluation plan draft). Can you confirm owner for meeting facilitation and whether Thursdays at 10am PT works for Redwood? We have procurement on standby for week-of Feb 23 to review licensing.

Thanks,
Sarah Liu
Senior Product Manager — Acme Systems
[sent from mobile]

Attachment: ACME_MAP_EvalPlan_v2.pdf (application/pdf, 420KB)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Proposed weekly MAP checkpoint: evaluation plan & owners

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear note and for sharing the eval plan. Short answer: we want the weekly checkpoint, but Thursdays at 10am PT will be tough for our EMEA stakeholders and for our infra sync (we have a standing ops window). Two options that could work:

1) Move the recurrence to Wednesdays at 08:00am PT (11:00am ET / 16:00 CET) so EMEA can join live once every two weeks, or
2) Keep Thursdays at 10am PT but implement an explicit owner-rotation + asynchronous notes so EMEA contributors can update the shared doc ahead of the meeting.

I propose we try option 2 for the first month to avoid disrupting established calendars, but rotate facilitation weekly between Redwood and Acme so owners are explicit. Suggested owners:
- Week 1 (Feb 19): Marissa Cole (Redwood) — agenda & notes
- Week 2 (Feb 26): Sarah Liu (Acme) — focus on eval metrics review
- Week 3 (Mar 4): Priyom Das (Redwood) — procurement readiness checkpoint

I attached a calendar invite draft (calendar-invite.ics) with a 30m weekly slot starting Feb 19 — please confirm whether Acme can accept and which weeks you need procurement to attend.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
